The plate is a square plate of about 26 cm across, and the waffle spans roughly 55% of that, so it is about 14–15 cm in diameter. Its thickness is about 1.5 cm. A round waffle of this size usually weighs about 110–130 g. There is a small amount of syrup pooled in the wells, which I count as its own item at about 10 g.
